barks.text: Another perfect day to be broke in paradise.
barks.speaker: civilian

barks.text: Is the whole city this shiny or just this street?
barks.speaker: tourist

barks.text: Cold water, cold water! Two bucks, beat the heat!
barks.speaker: vendor

barks.text: Move along, folks. Nothing here worth a photo.
barks.speaker: cop

barks.text: If I stand near the towers, maybe some money rubs off.
barks.speaker: civilian

barks.text: The app promised dolphins. All I see is traffic.
barks.speaker: tourist

barks.text: Keep your hands where the cameras can see them.
barks.speaker: cop

barks.text: Whatever that siren's about, it isn't me. Probably.
barks.speaker: civilian

barks.text: Downtown's hot today. Eyes up, wallet deep.
barks.speaker: gangster

barks.text: Did not sign up for a chase scene on my lunch break.
barks.speaker: civilian

barks.text: Is this normal? Everyone's walking so fast.
barks.speaker: tourist

barks.text: Glass towers in a lightning storm. Love that for us.
barks.speaker: civilian

barks.text: Off the streets. The pretty part of town floods too.
barks.speaker: cop

barks.text: My umbrella became modern art in three seconds flat.
barks.speaker: tourist

barks.text: Bottle service costs more than my rent. Worth it.
barks.speaker: tourist

barks.text: Fresh leis, glow sticks, bad decisions, right here!
barks.speaker: vendor

barks.text: The yachts get bigger every year and I get smaller.
barks.speaker: civilian

barks.text: Smile for the marina. Everybody's somebody's mark.
barks.speaker: gangster

barks.text: Came for the sunset, stayed for the open bar.
barks.speaker: tourist

barks.text: Marina's closed. Yes, even the big boat. Especially that one.
barks.speaker: cop

barks.text: The sunset cruise is now a survive-the-swells cruise.
barks.speaker: tourist

barks.text: Rich or broke, the surge doesn't read the room.
barks.speaker: civilian

barks.text: Mango, mango con chile! Best on the block, ask anyone.
barks.speaker: vendor

barks.text: Abuela says the block's changed. Abuela says that daily.
barks.speaker: civilian

barks.text: Low and slow down the boulevard, that's the whole plan.
barks.speaker: civilian

barks.text: Two tacos: one for now, one for the walk. Trust me.
barks.speaker: vendor

barks.text: This mural beats anything downtown, honestly.
barks.speaker: tourist

barks.text: This corner's spoken for. Keep it moving, friend.
barks.speaker: gangster

barks.text: When the music stops early, you go home early.
barks.speaker: civilian

barks.text: We got calls about this block. Don't make it three.
barks.speaker: cop

barks.text: Pull the shutters, mija. Not our night to watch.
barks.speaker: civilian

barks.text: Griot's ready, plantain's hot, eat before it's gone!
barks.speaker: vendor

barks.text: Drums till midnight, then the aunties take requests.
barks.speaker: civilian

barks.text: Don't know this song, but my hips figured it out.
barks.speaker: tourist

barks.text: Fresh juice, cold and sweet, keep the parade moving!
barks.speaker: vendor

barks.text: Whole block's family tonight, even the strangers.
barks.speaker: civilian

barks.text: Nothing ships through the Mill without somebody knowing.
barks.speaker: gangster

barks.text: Third shift at the plant, third shift of pretending I'm fine.
barks.speaker: civilian

barks.text: You didn't see a truck. There was no truck. Understand?
barks.speaker: cop

barks.text: Rust hides a lot of sins down here. Don't add one.
barks.speaker: gangster

barks.text: Airboat's the only ride when the roads go under.
barks.speaker: civilian

barks.text: Gettin' out before the water does. You should too.
barks.speaker: vendor

barks.text: Gators don't check the forecast. Neither do fools.
barks.speaker: civilian

barks.text: Storm's comin' sideways. Bring the dog in, leave the truck.
barks.speaker: civilian

barks.text: Out here the loudest thing is the bugs, and I like it.
barks.speaker: civilian

barks.text: Fresh catch, smoked mullet, pull over and try it!
barks.speaker: vendor

barks.text: City folk get lost out here. We just let 'em.
barks.speaker: civilian
